checks.detail: Dedicated SPI3 device, CS pin config -1 for tied-low board, SPI mode1. 55 clocks transmit8 opcode+8status+32data+7CRC; only after exact descriptor return does GPIO issue the final rising edge, sample physical MISO after1us, then issue falling edge and return SCLK low. No extra byte, nonexistent NOP, synthetic CRC bit, or shortened ADC data field.

ADS1262/3 manual permits CS tied low only for dedicated bus, changes DOUT at rising SCLK and requires SCLK low after sequence. TIMEOUT=0 has no minimum SCLK frequency, permitting the software handoff pause. The1us sample delay exceeds the stated60ns DOUT maximum only under the datasheet loading/voltage conditions; it is not board waveform measurement.

Fresh board bus initialization plus sole add-device establish capability; helper-created/already initialized/unproven bus and active/quarantined cold presence reject. Same ADS mutex covers prefix DMA and GPIO completion. Unknown get_result completion or wrong descriptor retains in-flight descriptor/buffers, invalidates interface proof, quarantines, and never steals SCLK.

Known55 completion after work expiry still completes exactly one edge pair and restores route before returning timeout without publishing a valid sample. Wrong post-DMA clock level, high/low/readback failure, or route restoration failure quarantines. Generic SPI then rejects further transfers. Deinit uses nonblocking exact-descriptor reclaim before removing DRDY ISR and freeing storage; it does not claim a timed-out DMA was cancelled. GPIO path neither disables IRQs nor feeds WDT.

One operation deadline bounds lock/queue/completion waits; outer helper work/cleanup share a final deadline. Cleanup is a finite edge/readback sequence. Tick rounding and task preemption mean elapsed completion is not a hard microsecond real-time guarantee; no unbounded cancel loop or renewed work budget was found.

Unreceived bit is cleared only in prefix storage, then replaced solely by gpio_get_level result. Computed CRC is diagnostic/comparison only. Standard parser compares the whole received/assembled8-bit CRC against polynomial0x07 over4ADC data bytes. Wrong physical0/1 tail or actual data corruption rejects raw/status output; all256 CRC byte patterns were exercised by production-C host test.

Required science policy admits physically recognized ADS1262 only, stopped ADC, dedicated known route, STATUS+CRC8 and verified INTERFACE0x06 with serial TIMEOUT off. Forced chip type alone is insufficient. Generic compile-time ADC2 support is not actual ADS1262 ADC2 capability. Missing REQUIRED capability is explicit error, not byte-SPI fallback.

INTERFACE write/reset observation/uncertain DMA/failed restore invalidate physical proof. Snapshot restoration re-reads core/calibration registers, RESET and INTERFACE; failed cleanup does not republish valid register cache. Fresh generation and NEW_DATA guards remain. Helper completion advances transaction generation and next matrix frame invalidates profile/value caches; diagnostic AA data never populate science caches. CRC firstError cannot hide a later terminal timeout/configuration/quarantine failure from matrix disposition.

Science uses selected GPIO policy at both raw entrypoints; STD diagnostics explicitly override only their transaction. Existing voltage/resistance equations, PGA constraints, mode identity and encoder were not changed by finalbit policy. Split diagnostics label wireKnown=false and report prefix plus sampled bit rather than claiming7 complete SPI bytes. CRC-valid transport is not ADC analog accuracy or fixture calibration PASS.

physical_proof_limits: GPIO configuration/level readback and software timestamps do not demonstrate absence of handoff glitches, ringing, overshoot or pad-level nanosecond setup/hold margin. Oscilloscope/logic-analyzer evidence is NOT_RUN in this review.

gpio_get_io_config checks exposed pin/route/OE fields, not a complete electrical path. Correct current board SPI initialization and exclusive ownership remain assumptions supported by source; readback is not measured analog isolation.

TIMEOUT is intentionally disabled for interrupted final-byte completion. An unknown/incomplete frame is quarantined; the design depends on controlled restart rather than claiming serial autoreset repaired it.

ADC CRC covers4 conversion data bytes only. STATUS, RREG and the analog transfer/reference are not protected by that CRC; reset/status/configuration checks remain necessary, and finite CRC cannot prove all corruptions impossible.

Observed zero failures over3 short windows does not establish failure-free operation for other boards, revisions, wiring, temperature, supply/load, clocks, every mode or long durations. No probability bound is inferred without independence assumptions.
The2MHz sequential comparison changes both sampling path and read duration/clock handoff, so it supports an effective workaround under tested conditions but cannot identify a unique physical cause.
No precision PASS is issued for floating VOLT fixture or10k/33pF calibration. Scientific invalid flags/X12/OPEN retain their own meanings separate from SPI CRC.

references.facts: tSCLK>=125ns, high/low>=40ns, DOUT propagation<=60ns at specified load; TIMEOUT disabled gives no minimumSCLK frequency.
CS tiedlow on dedicatedbus; DOUT updates on risingedge; returnSCLKlow.
TIMEOUT autoreset applies onlywhen enabled; falseSCLK can desynchronize.
RDATA1 loads holdingregister; command requiredperread; no commandaccepted untilreadcomplete/CS high.
CRC checks fourADC1databytes only with CRC8ATM polynomial.
